documentation.content: More than ${CLIENT_ERROR_THRESHOLD} crash reports from one app (website or phone) in 10 minutes. One student's broken page does not reach this; a bad deploy or a broken page many people visit does. The service label names the app. Open Error Reporting for the grouped issues, or Logs Explorer with `jsonPayload.activity="client.error"`. Runbook: docs/observability/README.md.
